name: PLS
recent: PLS Plantations 将于 2026 年 12 月 2 日召开第 39 届年度股东大会，寻求股东批准续期关联方交易授权及发行新股授权。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度仍录得亏损，净亏损 916 万令吉，净利率为 -36.4%。近期公告以月度产量数据、季度报告及股东大会相关文件为主。
notable: 将于 2026 年 12 月 2 日召开第 39 届年度股东大会。
并寻求批准董事发行新股及豁免优先认购权。
截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收 2,517.7 万令吉，净亏损 916.2 万令吉。
risks: 季度净亏损 916.2 万令吉，亏损较上年同期扩大。
净利率由上一季度的 -17.7% 下降至 -36.4%。
若落实可能摊薄现有股东持股。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 2,517.7 万令吉，环比增长 30.8%，同比增长 3.0%；净亏损为 916.2 万令吉，净利率为 -36.4%，上一季度为 -17.7%。

recent_en: The company remained loss-making for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, with a net loss of RM9.16 million and a net margin of -36.4%. Recent announcements mainly comprise monthly production figures, quarterly reports and AGM-related documents.
notable_en: The 39th Annual General Meeting will be held on 2 December 2026.
Proposes to renew the shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions and seeks approval for directors to issue new shares with waiver of pre-emptive rights.
For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM25.177 million and net loss was RM9.162 million.
risks_en: Quarterly net loss of RM9.162 million, with loss widening year-on-year.
Net margin declined to -36.4% from -17.7% in the previous quarter.
Proposed new share issuance with waiver of pre-emptive rights may dilute existing shareholders if implemented.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM25.177 million, up 30.8% QoQ and 3.0% YoY; net loss was RM9.162 million with a net margin of -36.4%, versus -17.7% in the previous quarter.
